title: Words of one face
description: The words one language's paper shows for one face of a card: the name, the type line, and the rules text. For a base words file the type line is the one every print shows; a print whose words differ may hold its own (Summon Djinn, for example).

name.description: The name of this face as printed in this language.

type_line.description: The type line as this face shows it in this language.
